title: Home Mortgage Loans: payoff statement, lien release and payoff escrow refund timelines
content:
# Home Mortgage Loans: payoff statement, lien release and payoff escrow refund timelines

This document gives, for every Home Mortgage Loans program, how soon a payoff statement is sent and what it costs, how soon the deed of trust satisfaction is recorded after payoff, and how soon the remaining escrow is refunded after payoff.

## Timelines by program

| Program | Payoff statement sent within (business days after the request) | Payoff statement fee (USD) | Deed of trust satisfaction recorded within (calendar days after payoff) | Remaining escrow refunded within (calendar days after payoff) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| FHA 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | 7 | 0.00 | 30 | 30 |
| VA 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | 7 | 0.00 | 30 | 30 |
| Conventional 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | 7 | 0.00 | 30 | 30 |
| Conventional 15-Year Fixed Mortgage | 7 | 0.00 | 30 | 30 |
| 7/6 SOFR Adjustable-Rate Mortgage | 7 | 0.00 | 30 | 30 |
| Jumbo 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | 7 | 0.00 | 30 | 30 |

## Wrong reading and correct basis

| Wrong reading | Correct basis |
|---|---|
| All three periods count calendar days. | The payoff statement period counts business days after the request; the lien satisfaction period and the escrow refund period count calendar days after the payoff. |
| The two 30-day periods start from the payoff request. | Both 30-day periods run from the payoff, not from the request for a statement. |
| A payoff statement carries a fee in some programs. | The payoff statement fee is 0.00 in all six programs. |

## Basis Q&A

- **Do any programs differ on these timelines?** No; all six programs use 7 business days, a fee of 0.00, and 30 calendar days for both the lien satisfaction and the escrow refund.
